name: flag-tag-arena-game
description: 2D Online Multiplayer Flag-Tag Arena Game with Phaser 3, Node.js, and Socket.IO

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'server'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'client'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
